heroSubtitle: Turn an idea into a clear blueprint, compare builder offers, and pay only as each milestone is approved.
howSubtitle: A structured path from first description to final deployment — with clarity at every step.

scope.title: Scope
scope.body: Describe your idea in plain language. Get an AI-generated blueprint with features, milestones, and out-of-scope — refine until it’s right.

compare.title: Compare & agree
compare.body: Publish to builders, review offers side by side, negotiate terms, and accept a final plan that locks scope and budget.

fund.title: Fund & ship
fund.body: Fund escrow across 3 milestones (30/40/30). Builders submit demo bundles, you review, and release payment on approval.

clientsTitle: Turn uncertainty into a plan you can trust
clientsSubtitle: Idea Launch helps non-technical and technical clients alike move from a rough idea to a funded, reviewable project — without guessing at scope or paying everything upfront.

ai.title: AI-assisted scoping
ai.body: Describe your idea, budget, and timeline in plain language. Get a structured blueprint — summary, features, milestones, and what’s out of scope — then refine it before you publish.

compare.title: Compare offers on equal terms
compare.body: Review proposals from multiple builders side by side. Each offer includes a total budget, milestone schedule, deliverable targets, and timeline so you can choose with confidence.

negotiate.title: Negotiate, then lock the plan
negotiate.body: Select one builder to discuss terms in a focused conversation. When the offer is final and you accept, the agreed scope, milestones, and budget become the shared source of truth.

escrow.title: Milestone-based escrow protection
escrow.body: Fund a fixed total split across three milestones. Payment is released only when you approve each submitted demo bundle — you pay for approved progress, not promises.

review.title: Review-driven delivery
review.body: Builders submit staged demos for review. Approve to move forward, or request changes with clear feedback — progress stays transparent from first demo to deployment.

buildersTitle: Build with clarity, deliver with confidence
buildersSubtitle: Spend less time decoding vague requests and more time shipping. Idea Launch gives builders structured projects, explicit terms, and milestone-based releases.

scope.title: Clear, standardized scope
scope.body: Start from a published blueprint with defined features, milestones, and deliverable expectations — less guesswork, fewer surprises, and a shared understanding from day one.

offer.title: One focused offer per project
offer.body: Submit a single, structured offer with your proposed total, milestone dates, and delivery targets. When selected, negotiate terms directly with the client and finalize when you’re aligned.

feedback.title: Staged demos, explicit feedback
feedback.body: Deliver work as milestone demo bundles and get concrete review outcomes. If changes are requested, you know exactly what to address before the next approval.

payout.title: Get paid per approved milestone
payout.body: Escrow is tied to the agreed plan. As each milestone is approved, the corresponding portion is released — predictable payouts tied to delivered, accepted progress.

sustainable.title: Built for sustainable work
sustainable.body: Capacity and eligibility rules keep workloads manageable, while transparent terms and milestone structure help you focus on building instead of chasing clarity or payment.

ctaTitle: Ready to turn an idea into a shipped project?
ctaSubtitle: Start with a clear blueprint, find the right builder, and move forward one approved milestone at a time.
ctaNote: Start with a scope · Fund only when you accept a final offer
